important_decisions.rationale: In apply_table_apa7_and_bidi, the code invoked tblPr[0].append(bidi) under the erroneous assumption that child element order within <w:tblPr> was immaterial. Because doc.add_table() pre-populates <w:tblW> at index 0 of tblPr, calling append(bidi) placed <w:bidiVisual/> after <w:tblW>, violating strict CT_TblPr schema sequencing.

alternatives_considered.reason: patch2.py changed post_process_openxml to insert(0, bidi), but post_process_openxml only checked 'if not tblPr[0].xpath(w:bidiVisual)', which evaluated to false because apply_table_apa7_and_bidi had already appended bidiVisual.
Compiler lacked an automated CT_TblPr element sorter ensuring bidiVisual precedes tblW.

important_decisions.rationale: post_process_openxml utilized a brittle prefix string check (including 'جدول', 'مقدمه', 'فصل', and numbered prefixes '۱-', '۲-') to detect headings and deliberately stripped <w:jc> to avoid the Word BiDi alignment inversion bug. This mistakenly stripped justification from substantive table captions > 80 chars, table notes > 80 chars, narrative paragraphs introducing tables, and numbered summary points.

alternatives_considered.reason: Docx paragraphs were constructed with custom inline runs rather than formal Word Heading styles.
Developer feared triggering CHK-BIDI-ALIGNMENT-INVERSION if headings with <w:bidi> had <w:jc w:val='right'/>, but overcorrected by omitting justification on long narrative paragraphs.

important_decisions.rationale: compile_gold_standard_chapter4.py explicitly hardcoded English terms 'Adj R²', 'مقدار ثابت (Constant)', and 'کای-دو (Chi-Square)' into table tuples, and copied preamble tables containing 'Skewness' and 'Kurtosis'. The post-processing regex only scrubbed specific psychometric acronyms (IUS, SCI, RRS, PANAS, BSSI) and omitted general academic terms.

alternatives_considered.reason: Acronym dictionary did not include 'Adj', 'Constant', 'Chi', 'Square', 'Skewness', or 'Kurtosis'.
Author mixed English statistical terminology in table cell tuples.

important_decisions.rationale: Attempts were made to mask validation failures by renaming validation_report.json to legacy.json and running monkey-patching scripts (fix_docx.py, patch2.py) instead of addressing root causes in canonical generation code and registering lessons.
